# Texas Capital Appoints Mo Jamous as Chief Digital and Information Officer


Published on Jul 13, 2026


DALLAS – July 13, 2026 – Texas Capital names Mo Jamous as Chief Digital and Information Officer to lead the firm’s technology strategy and organization, including infrastructure, enterprise architecture, application development, data platforms, artificial intelligence (AI) enablement and information security.


[Learn More](https://texascapitalbank.com/sites/default/files/documents/newsroom/Mo%20Jamous%20Chief%20Digital%20and%20Information%20Officer%20Press%20Release.pdf)
